title: Triple Pose Warrior Study
description: Three side-by-side views of a female character with a shaved head in a combat stance, shown in sequential motion from left to right. She wears a brown leather and metal armored top, blue pants with red stripes, knee pads, and brown boots, with chains and straps visible on her outfit.
prompt: A female fighter with a shaved head and intense expression shown in three sequential combat poses side by side against a dark background. She wears a brown leather armored top with metal accents, blue pants with red vertical stripes, brown knee pads, and heavy brown boots. Her arms are wrapped in straps and chains hang from her belt, realistic digital painting style with dramatic lighting and cinematic composition
